Stakeholders.title: To Our Stakeholders
Stakeholders.intro: I'm writing this page for you — my teammates, our users, and our investors — to explain what talkinbio is and how we're building it together.
Stakeholders.ctaTitle: Put your bio link to work.
Stakeholders.ctaBody: Setup takes 10 minutes. At the end of the first month, you look at the data and decide.

q1.title: Why Now
q1.content:
For individual service providers running their business on social media, something changed over the last three years. DMs used to be where you talked about content; now they're where the actual selling happens. Booking a slot, asking about price, negotiating, deciding — all of it now flows through social media DMs. And sellers are drowning in that traffic.

The opening of WhatsApp Business API to individual accounts added another layer: a seller can now technically reach an infrastructure that lets them speak with one voice across every channel — but there's no tool to set it up, run it, and grow with it.

The big players either didn't see this gap or didn't care about it; none of them built for individual service providers. We're building the solution right inside it.

q2.title: What Happens If Nothing Changes
q2.content:
A customer asks a question. The reply comes four hours later. The customer has already gone to someone else — and the seller doesn't even notice.

This plays out every day, across tens of thousands of the 600,000 individual sellers out there. The revenue loss is invisible, because nobody says 'I lost one.' The customer just leaves. Nothing gets counted.

Let's make this concrete for investors (an estimate from our Fermi model): a seller gets about 10 DMs a day, and roughly 40% of those carry real buying intent. Because of response delays, 2 of those 4 potential customers are lost. At an average transaction value of $20, that's about $14,600 in lost revenue a year for a single seller. Multiply that across the whole market, and the damage becomes hard to even calculate.

q3.title: Why Existing Alternatives Fall Short
q3.content:
Linktree gives you a showcase, but it doesn't answer the visitor's question. Someone clicking a seller's link wants to learn about the service — and there's no one there to talk to.

ManyChat and similar chatbots fill that gap with technical complexity instead: setup is hard, flows are rigid and brittle. Designing a separate flow for every question requires technical skill most individuals just don't have the time for.

The big CRMs (HubSpot, Pipedrive) are overkill for a coach or a beauty professional. Onboarding takes weeks, pricing runs on annual contracts, integration needs technical know-how — these products were built for businesses with an IT department, not for individuals.

WhatsApp Business on its own doesn't solve it either: a question comes in, someone answers it by hand. No automation, no follow-up, no analytics — just slightly more organized messaging.

None of them combine a 24/7 assistant that answers questions, qualifies visitors, builds a lead list, and hands the seller marketing suggestions. That's exactly the gap talkinbio fills.

q4.title: What We Do
q4.content:
talkinbio has two parts.

Assistant Agent is the AI assistant that works 24/7 on your bio page. When a visitor asks a question, it listens, understands, and answers like someone who actually knows your business. It books appointments, logs interested visitors, and flags anything that needs follow-up. When you wake up, you're not looking at missed DMs — you're looking at a sorted, tagged lead list.

Creative Agent analyzes those conversations and turns them into weekly marketing suggestions. 'What question came up most this week? Which service got the most interest? What times did visitors show up?' Creative Agent answers those questions, so your next content decision is based on data instead of a guess.

Setup takes 10 minutes, no code required. And once the system is running, it keeps working whether you're at your desk or not.

q5.title: What Makes Us Different
q5.content:
Every Assistant Agent conversation carries a small signature underneath it: 'You're chatting with Assistant Agent — talkinbio.com.' Everyone who visits a seller's page sees it. And some of them think 'I want that on my own page too' and sign up. So the product grows itself — CAC stays organic without any paid marketing.

That produces a few advantages. First, a viral loop: every active assistant becomes a channel for acquiring new users.

Second, accumulated conversation data: the more Creative Agent gets used, the more specialized it becomes. A new competitor can't copy that data advantage overnight — our early users are giving us a strategic head start in data richness.

Third, a local-first architecture: we're already building the localization skeleton that adapts to markets with different languages and payment infrastructure (MENA, LatAm). That means our v2 expansion won't have to start from zero.

q6.title: Our Revenue Model
q6.content:
Our revenue model is a credit-based subscription. Billing infrastructure ships as part of our roadmap's launch gate; for now, we collect payment manually from early pilots. We have three tiers.

Starter ($9/month, 200 credits) is for the individual seller getting 3-5 DMs a day, setting up an assistant for the first time. Users at this tier are learning what Assistant Agent does and testing whether it's worth it.

Pro ($29/month, 700 credits) is for sellers getting 30+ DMs a week, with a steady customer base, who use Creative Agent's analytics. This tier is our real revenue engine.

Business ($79/month, 1,800 credits) is for sellers running multiple service lines, handling high DM volume, with automation needs that have outgrown the basics.

Pricing is dollar-fixed; we collect in lira at the current exchange rate. Annual billing comes with a 20% discount — savings for the customer, and a buffer against currency risk for us.

In numbers: effective ARPU is $15, LTV is $300 (assuming 5% churn), and we're targeting a CAC under $100 — our viral signature loop should keep that organic.

q7.title: Where We're Headed
q7.content:
Right now we're in Stage 1: Problem/Solution Fit. The one metric we track (OMTM) is paying customers, and the counter currently reads 0/10. Our goal: finish 20 problem interviews, confirm the pain points that keep repeating, and get the first 10 pilots paying $9/month.

Stage 2 (550 customers, $100K ARR) is proof of Problem/Solution Fit — crossing that line also tells us whether the viral loop actually works. That's where investor conversations start.

Stage 3 is v2 Global: direct WhatsApp and Instagram DM integration, MENA and LatAm localization, new languages. In our base scenario that's roughly 4,500 customers and $810K ARR — Assistant Agent stops living only on the bio page and starts working across every channel. In a more optimistic scenario (6% global capture), that grows to roughly 9,000 customers and $1.6M ARR.

Every step needs proof from the one before it. Right now, we're focused on exactly one thing: the first 10 payments.

Long-term, we don't see talkinbio as just a tool for individuals. Assistant Agent and Creative Agent are turning into an agent infrastructure that runs across every channel a business communicates through. We're not naming that yet — the product will speak for itself.

q8.title: How We Work
q8.content:
We follow the Running Lean methodology — not as a slogan, but as the framework that directly shapes how we work.

We validate the problem before we build the product. Customer interviews get finished before development does; if 20 interviews don't surface a recurring pain point, we do more.

We don't offer a free trial — that's not a preference, it's a methodological choice. Ash Maurya's Running Lean is clear on this: free early access collects the curious, not customers. Our first 10 paying customers are the real test of the value hypothesis — payment is commitment.

We keep a Continuous Improvement panel: the Lean Canvas, the Fermi Estimate, the Traction Roadmap, and the Lean Sales Pitch — all of them, including the page you're reading right now, are living documents. They get updated as things change, and saved every time they do. Version discipline is a standard here, not an exception.

We keep our evidence classes visible: what's validated is marked validated, what isn't is marked as such. Inflated claims of proof don't get a pass.

q9.title: What We're Asking For
q9.content:
From our users: setup takes 10 minutes. Connect your bio link to talkinbio, and watch how many leads Assistant Agent collects over a month. If it doesn't create value, don't continue. If it does, now you know.

From our investors: we're an early-stage, bootstrapped startup right now. The right time for an investment conversation is once we cross $100K ARR — but rather than make you wait until then, we wanted to introduce ourselves early. Our numbers are marked by evidence class: validated is validated, estimated is estimated, and the open questions stay open. We'll reach out when we're ready.

From our team: come back to this page whenever you need a reminder of why building this matters. We believe what we're doing is right — proving it is the only thing left to do.

Legal.title: Privacy Policy & GDPR Notice
Legal.copy: talkinbio takes the privacy and security of your personal data seriously. This page explains how we collect, use and protect your data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable privacy laws.

sections.title: 1. Data Controller
sections.body:
talkinbio is currently operated as a sole proprietorship while formal company incorporation is in progress; the registered data controller identity (company name, registration number) will be updated on this page once incorporation is complete. Personal data collected through the platform is processed in accordance with applicable data protection law, including the GDPR. Contact: info@talkinbio.com

Important distinction: business owners using the talkinbio platform (our customers) are the data controller for data they collect from their own visitors/end customers (e.g. conversations with Assistant Agent, lead information) — talkinbio acts as a data processor for that data. For the account holder's own data (name, email, account information), talkinbio is the data controller.

sections.title: 2. Personal Data We Collect
sections.body:
talkinbio provides an AI assistant (Assistant Agent) that chats 24/7 with visitors to your social media bio page. Two separate categories of data are processed:

Your data as a business owner (account holder):
• Identity data: Full name
• Contact data: Email address
• Account data: Business name, username, industry/category
• Usage and metering data: Login timestamps, in-platform actions, AI usage volume (credit/token consumption)

Data belonging to visitors to your page (your end customers) — for this data, you are the data controller and talkinbio is the data processor:
• Transcripts of conversations with Assistant Agent (including messages the visitor writes)
• Lead information: name, contact details, preferred appointment time
• A session cookie named visitor_session_id (used to match a visitor to their own conversation history)

Assistant Agent is an AI assistant; when a visitor asks directly, it honestly discloses this. These conversations may be read by the business owner providing the service and are sent to an AI provider to generate responses (see Section 4).

sections.title: 3. Legal Basis for Processing
sections.body:
We process your personal data under the following legal bases under GDPR Article 6:

• Account creation and authentication → Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b))
• Providing platform services (page hosting, Assistant Agent/Creative Agent assistants) → Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b))
• AI-assisted visitor communication (Assistant Agent answering questions, collecting appointments/leads) → Performance of a contract + legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(b), 6(1)(f))
• Security and audit logs → Legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f))
• Product development, error analysis and usage metering (credit/token consumption) → Legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f))
• Legal compliance (invoicing, accounting records) → Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c))
• Marketing communications → Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)) — only where you have given explicit consent

sections.title: 4. Data Transfers
sections.body:
To provide our service, your personal data is transferred to the following technical infrastructure providers (acting as data processors):

• Supabase — database, authentication and file storage
• Vercel — application hosting
• Anthropic — the AI model provider powering Assistant Agent's and Creative Agent's responses; conversation content is sent to Anthropic (based in the United States) for this purpose
• Resend — sending system and notification emails

Some of these providers are located outside the European Economic Area. Where data is transferred outside the EEA, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place in accordance with GDPR Chapter V, including Standard Contractual Clauses where applicable. Data may also be transferred to competent public authorities where legally required.

sections.title: 5. Data Retention
sections.body:
We retain your personal data as follows:

• Account and platform data: for as long as your account is active; deleted or anonymized within 90 days of account closure.
• Assistant Agent conversation transcripts and lead data: retained for as long as the related business account is active (accessible to the business owner); deleted within 90 days of account closure.
• Invoicing and accounting records: retained for the period required by applicable tax law.
• Security and audit logs: retained for up to 12 months.

If a visitor requests deletion of their conversation data, the request is directed to the relevant business owner (the data controller); talkinbio, as data processor, carries out the technical deletion.

sections.title: 6. Your Rights Under GDPR
sections.body:
Under GDPR, you have the following rights:

• Right of access — to obtain a copy of your personal data
• Right to rectification — to correct inaccurate or incomplete data
• Right to erasure ('right to be forgotten') — to request deletion of your data
• Right to restriction of processing
• Right to data portability
• Right to object — including to processing based on legitimate interests
• Rights related to automated decision-making and profiling

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at info@talkinbio.com. We will respond within 30 days. If you are not satisfied with our response, you have the right to lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority.

sections.title: 7. Cookies
sections.body: The talkinbio platform currently uses only strictly necessary cookies for session management and security (e.g. the visitor_session_id cookie used to match a visitor to their own conversation history, and login session cookies). We do not currently use analytics or marketing cookies; if this changes, a consent banner will be added before any such cookie is set. You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings.

sections.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: talkinbio reserves the right to update this Privacy Policy. Significant changes will be communicated to your registered email address. The current version is always available on this page.

sections.title: 9. Contact
sections.body: For all privacy-related requests and GDPR inquiries, please contact us at: info@talkinbio.com

instagramIntegration.description: Connect your business account to have incoming DMs handled automatically by your assistant. This feature is currently in development and temporarily disabled.

instagramIntegration.workaroundTitle: In the meantime: add your page link to Instagram
instagramIntegration.workaroundDesc: Add this link to your instant reply message and anyone who DMs you will be redirected to your TalkinBio page.
instagramIntegration.guideIntro: If you have a Business or Professional Instagram account, you can automate this redirect by adding your TalkinBio link to your "Instant Reply" message:
instagramIntegration.guideStep1: Open your profile in the Instagram app and tap "Business tools and controls" from the top-right menu.
instagramIntegration.guideStep2: Go to "Automated responses" → "Instant reply" and turn the feature on.
instagramIntegration.guideStep3: Add your TalkinBio page link to the message text: {link}
instagramIntegration.guideStep4: Save the change — anyone who DMs you now receives that message with a link to your TalkinBio page.
instagramIntegration.guideNote: Note: Instant Reply is only available on Professional/Business Instagram accounts.

BeiweLab.twinDesc: A production line that turns a face into a verified AI twin.
BeiweLab.voiceDesc: A production line that turns an audio recording into an approved voice clone.
BeiweLab.podcastDesc: A production line that turns liked scenes into talking videos.
BeiweLab.postDesc: A layer that turns a screen recording, frame or plain text into a brand-templated post.
BeiweLab.castDesc: Virtual characters generated by description, not locked to a real face.
BeiweLab.motionDesc: AI actor, anime, cartoon, cinematic, fantastic and trending videos — a production line focusing on full-body visuals without voice association.
BeiweLab.studioDesc: A layer that adds cutaway, overlay and music over video clips and produces formatted exports.
BeiweLab.twinStage1Desc: The frames you upload are first analyzed by the vision model and the person's permanent identity prompt is extracted. Every twin generation uses this prompt and the reference frame — the face doesn't change even if the scene changes.
BeiweLab.twinStage2Desc: In this stage, identity is tested, not the scene. Generate {score} fixed angles and score each frame for similarity. If at least one frame gets {score}+, the twin is considered verified.
BeiweLab.twinStage2Locked: Teach Face (Stage 1) must be completed first.
BeiweLab.twinStage3Desc: Frames scoring {minScore}+ enter the training set. When the set reaches {threshold} frames, a custom LoRA model can be trained for the person — after that, every generation is based on the model itself, not the reference image.
BeiweLab.twinFaceUpload: Upload 2-3 clear reference photos from different angles (front, left, right)
BeiweLab.twinLoraNeedMoreShots: Need at least {minShots} shots with 80+ score (Currently: {currentShots})
BeiweLab.twinLoraMinCost: You need at least {cost} credits in your account to start this.
BeiweLab.voiceStage1Question: Whose voice is this clone born from?
BeiweLab.voiceStage1NoCharacterVoice: {name} is a virtual character — it has no voice of its own. You must select one from the preset voice library below or record a new voice as an admin.
BeiweLab.voiceNoPresets: No preset voices added yet. Add the first one below — this library will be available to all businesses.
BeiweLab.voiceUploadCost: Uploading an audio file (automatic transcription) costs {cost}.
BeiweLab.voiceUploadSuccess: Duration and volume level look reasonable. This does not guarantee the clone will sound like you.
BeiweLab.voiceUploadFallback: Or upload your own audio file
BeiweLab.voiceUploadWarning: Changing the reference invalidates the current clone — you will need to re-run stage 2.
BeiweLab.voicePresetLabelRequired: Type a label for the preset voice first (e.g. 'Warm female').
BeiweLab.voiceStage2Question: Should this voice turn into a permanent identity?
BeiweLab.voiceStage2Desc1: This is the voice equivalent of LoRA in Twin: the reference is processed once to become a permanent identity.
BeiweLab.voiceStage2Desc2: Every subsequent generation uses this identity, not the audio file.
BeiweLab.voiceStage2Desc3: Note: The cloning fee for this stage is the cost of creating the clone ITSELF; since MiniMax doesn't offer free previews, you must purchase the clone first.
BeiweLab.voiceStage2Desc4: A new identity is automatically deleted if not used in a real voiceover within {days} days; the first 'Voiceover' in stage 3 resets this timer.
BeiweLab.voiceStage3Question: Does this voice really sound like you?
BeiweLab.voiceStage3Desc1: The sentences below are actual sentences the product will generate — let's see if the clone works.
BeiweLab.voiceStage3Desc2: Quality is flawless, but similarity (how close it sounds to the person's voice) is yet uncertain. If it doesn't match, you can retry from stage 1 with another clean/long source recording. Approval locks this specific clone into the brand's production pipeline.
BeiweLab.voiceCustomPlaceholder: Write a sentence you expect the clone to struggle with.
BeiweLab.voiceApprovedNotice: Clone approved — Beiwe Motion will use this voice.
BeiweLab.voiceTwinNotVerified: The visual twin of this character is not verified yet. The voice layer works independently but both must be approved for production.
BeiweLab.castNewDesc: A virtual, fictional character — not locked to a real face, generated solely by description.
BeiweLab.castNameAndPersonaRequired: Name and persona description are required.
BeiweLab.castPersonaPlaceholder: Persona (appearance + personality) — e.g. In their thirties, short black hair, energetic sports coach. Warm and motivating demeanor.
BeiweLab.castEmpty: You haven't created a supporting cast yet.
BeiweLab.simCaptionDefault: How much does this shot look like you?
BeiweLab.postSavedMessage: Saved — you can access it from the gallery in Beiwe Studio.
BeiweLab.postTemplateDesc: Typography, position, and color are locked inside the template — this is what makes the grid look like a brand. You only choose the text, image, and format.
BeiweLab.postMotionDesc: Headline/subline slides in, image slowly zooms in, a slight light ray moves across the background — turns into a ~4 sec clip. Duration and curve are locked like the template.
BeiweLab.postImageContain: Screen recording/screenshot is framed, not cropped — the entire interface remains visible.
BeiweLab.postImageCard: Sits as a small thumbnail on the left of the card — optional, can be left empty.
BeiweLab.postImageCover: Image bleeds completely and is cropped according to the format.
BeiweLab.postRemoveBgTitle: Removes the background from the image using fal.ai — the object/person is separated from the background.
BeiweLab.postTextHeadlinePlaceholder1: You write the same answer 15 times a day.
BeiweLab.postTextHeadlinePlaceholder2: The “what's the price?” question in DMs is closed in 3 seconds.
BeiweLab.postTextLayerNotice: Text is overlaid as a layer — generate posts in three languages from a single visual, no need to regenerate for corrections.
BeiweLab.postTipCardsDesc: Arranged as a 2x2 grid below the headline — empty ones are skipped.

BeiweLab.postSaveLibraryTitle: Saves to Beiwe Studio's common gallery — appears in sequence/cutaway/overlay pickers when you open the Studio.

BeiweLab.postTemplateEkranHint: Screenshot framed on a dark background, headline on top. Strongest content format.
BeiweLab.postTemplateDuyuruHint: Visual bleeds completely, dark overlay on top and large headline in the center.
BeiweLab.postTemplateAciHint: Visual bleeds completely, bottom shadow, headline bottom left. Designed for B-roll.
BeiweLab.postTemplateSozHint: No visual. Large text on coral background — zero production cost, establishes a rhythm in the grid.
BeiweLab.postTemplateObjeHint: Warm mesh-gradient background + light grain, object/person floating in the center. Designed for visuals with removed backgrounds.
BeiweLab.postTemplateGradientHint: Gradient background variant of 'X is live' — more vibrant, less corporate.
BeiweLab.postTemplateRakamHint: Unlike 'Quote': EXTREMELY large font for a single number/short phrase, with a subtle description below.
BeiweLab.postTemplateSinematikHint: Dark background + vignette + grain — to match the cinematic frames coming out of Beiwe Motion.
BeiweLab.postTemplateAlintiPillar: Quote/comment — can be used in a series
BeiweLab.postTemplateAlintiHint: Floating white card in the center — small image + quote + name. Saving several and sequencing them in Beiwe Studio's Sequence panel can create a 'cards appearing one by one' effect.
BeiweLab.postTemplateSinemaHint: Visual bleeds completely, heavy vignette with a fixed 'presents' label on top + centered headline/description — movie poster feel.
BeiweLab.postTemplateNeonHint: Visual bleeds completely, headline stands out with a neon glow — for parties/events/live moments.
BeiweLab.postTemplateManifestoHint: No visual, giant bold headline bottom-left on a light/paper-textured background — plenty of whitespace, like ElevenLabs' 'Like your voice. But different.' style.
BeiweLab.postTemplateAynaHint: Background split into two contrasting colors by a straight line, headline in the center — a flat/graphic sense of contrast.
BeiweLab.postTemplateIlhamHint: Badge + headline + 2x2 tip card grid below — for list content like '4 use-case ideas'.
BeiweLab.postTipCardsNotice: Arranged in a 2x2 grid below the headline — empty ones are skipped.

BeiweLab.podcastStep2Desc: Film yourself reading/gesturing the text you actually want to say — both motion and voice come from this video (video is generated silently and the video's original voice is directly transferred to the clip, we do not add another voice later). Shoot with good lighting and keep your hands in frame just like the canon image (if the model has to guess an unseen hand, it will look distorted).
